measurement_notes.ground_truth_accuracy: Exact full-answer correctness: expected outcome must match; conclusive targets also require the correct top service AND category. Inconclusive targets require abstention. Binary per case, averaged across all cases. Same criterion as case_success_rate.
measurement_notes.root_cause_accuracy: Top hypothesis service AND category match ground truth on conclusive-target cases; other cases are N/A. Provider-blocked eligible runs count as incorrect.
measurement_notes.evidence_grounding: Citation-ID validity proxy only: valid references / (valid + invalid references, including removed citations). Semantic claim support is not automatically assessed. No citations = N/A.
measurement_notes.tool_call_count: Total attempted tool calls including retries.
measurement_notes.latency_s: Per-run elapsed seconds; arithmetic mean across selected incidents in the summary.
measurement_notes.token_consumption: Recorded input + output tokens; excludes failed/canceled requests without recorded usage. Mock counts are estimates.
measurement_notes.errors: Exceptions escaping the investigator only; inspect termination_reason and report open_issues for internally handled provider failures.
